summary: Keep PSI brake recovery independent of slow reconciliation passes

schema.detail: No client schema, generated code or API shape changes.

rules.detail: A daemon-scoped sampler observes Linux PSI every quarter of the configured freshness interval. Slow reconciliation no longer resets healthy recovery. Missing, stale, malformed or interrupted observations still close admission; pressure thresholds and recovery durations are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing PSI policy configuration remains valid. Decision transition logs distinguish pressure, recovery and unavailable observations.

downtime.detail: The sampler takes effect after daemon restart.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no data migration.
